answer: Cross-identity answer-similarity detection resists sybils: every answer is fingerprinted and compared against all others that epoch, and a cluster of near-duplicate texts — same mechanism, same phrasings — marks a farm scripting one fable across many mouths. Pass each answer through a prism and honest ones scatter into distinct spectra; a sybil operator's template leaves them all one flat marble shade. The system flags the similarity cluster for re-grade and rejects the duplicates, so running N fakes off shared text turns the reuse the attacker wanted into the tell that exposes the ring.
